newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume soars to 2,111 kg, prices up.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume soars to 2,111 kg, prices up.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange trade remained unseasonably buoyant with 2,111 kilos of turnover on Friday, up sharply from Thursday's 1,046 kilos as banks continued to arbitrage heavily, dealers said.
Today's was the second biggest volume after the record 2,570 kilos traded on January 8.
Gold closed higher at $353.50 an ounce and 1,311,400 lira per gram, compared to Thursday's $349.50 and 1,298,300 lira, in line with the worldwide increase in gold prices.
Banks usually arbitrage by buying gold in dollars and selling in lira when gold prices and lira/dollar rates are suitable.
Of the day's volume, 1,361 kilos were done in the morning session and 52 percent of the total was traded in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
